opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record; hold a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award; have teaching and admin duties; based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research at the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities, in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and supported by the Leverhulme Trust. Awards up to £200,000 for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; no prior British Academy funding required; some prior public engagement experience expected; previous successful recipients not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a gallery, archive, library or museum (GLAM) or performing arts organisation. Awards up to £8,000.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany. Covers travel, accommodation and visa costs; seed funding available for collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: Covered under FEC regime; Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; any nationality with a UK doctorate eligible; Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based researchers ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO, intending to pursue original independent research within the Humanities or Social Sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports acquisition and advancement of skills in areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, enabling researchers to build skills and capacities for current and future research. Awards up to £10,000 for 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award; overseas Co-Applicants required; collaboration across disciplines required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based humanities/social sciences researchers with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines. Awards up to £300,000 over 2 years.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for UK-based early and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin. Up to two one-year fellowships, up to £150,000 each.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months; must meet eligibility for the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to the amount already requested for research expenses, e.g. specific equipment to overcome barriers, caring costs for research trips, assistance for sensory impairment, or support in making an application. Offered on a rolling deadline.
